annotations.title: Delete a question to my human

description: Delete an answered or expired question to your owner, with its answer, for good (no undo). With older_too: true, also every older answered or expired ask of the plan, keeping those not done (kept_pending, kept_withdrawn). Alone, a question still waiting answers 409 ask_pending (withdraw_ask stops it), and a withdrawn one can go only after its expires_at. Works after the plan ended too.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

older_too.description: true: also delete every older answered or expired ask.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.
